title: Color Contrast
summary: Text and non-text contrast thresholds differ by size and role; measure rendered combinations including states, dark mode and image backgrounds.

MUST.text: SC 1.4.3 AA: 4.5:1 normal text; 3:1 large text (>=24px regular or ~18.66px bold).
SC 1.4.11 AA: 3:1 for essential UI component boundaries and meaningful graphics.
SC 1.4.1: do not use color as the only means to convey information; add text, icon or shape redundancy.
Measure contrast on actual rendered backgrounds, including images, gradients and overlays.

SHOULD.text: Test hover, focus, disabled, placeholder, error and dark-mode states.
Prefer at least 4.5:1 for large text where feasible; avoid low-contrast placeholders for essential info.

AVOID.text: Do not apply the 3:1 large-text threshold to normal 16px text.
Do not rely on subtle borders or pale text as the only control boundary.

DECIDE.decision: Add scrim or solid backing to meet threshold
Re-measure; do not invert and assume pass
No contrast requirement if not meaningful

EXAMPLE.good: "Body text on hero image reaches 4.5:1 after a 40% scrim."

FAILURE_MODES: Contrast passes in design tool but fails over real image content.
Dark-mode palettes often drop below threshold.
Color-only status indicators fail for color-blind users.
